block.guhs.vadslamp.lore: On 1 chonk power: light level 15, and it lights up a much bigger area than a normal lamp
block.guhs.vadsschakelaar.aan: Switch on: the chonk power goes through
block.guhs.vadsschakelaar.lore: Put it in a line of Guh Wire: on, the chonk power goes through; off, everything behind it sleeps
block.guhs.vadsschakelaar.uit: Switch off: everything behind it sleeps
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_beurs.de: Somewhere in the Guhmension stands a glass hall where &devery guh machine really works&r: the &dGuh Technology Fair&r (your Super Compass finds it under Cozy). Every stand has a sign, a &dChonk Switch&r to turn it off and on and a fair guh who tells you which quest teaches it. The Dream Factory runs in the middle. Looking is fine, taking is not!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_quests_vadslamp: The &dChonk Lamp&r (a lantern, two Guh Wire and two glowstone dust) burns on 1 chonk power: it wakes up, looks happy and gives the brightest light there is. And it shines much further than a normal lamp: up to about 6 blocks around it, it puts down invisible extra light. One lamp lights up a whole cave. Without chonk power it goes back to sleep.
gui.guhs.techbeurs.kijken: Looking is fine, taking is not: this belongs to the fair!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.bezorg.1: Our Delivery Guhling delivers everything. Except the weekend, he keeps that for himself.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.bezorg.2: Recipe card at 'The Delivery Guhling' (Project 4), then 'The Scooter Station' and 'Stop Posts': green picks up, orange delivers.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.blub.1: The little stove eats cheese nibbles. So do I. We don't share.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.blub.2: Turn the switch off: the Nibble Battery keeps the lamps on! 'The Blub Stove' is in Project 3, the battery in Project 2.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.buizen.1: The nibbles go back and forth all day. They're having a great time.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.buizen.2: Start with 'From Chest to Chest' and 'The Filter Piece' in Project 2; the Stock Meter is at 'Enough Is Enough'.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.disco.1: These guhs have been dancing since the opening. The record still hasn't ended.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.disco.2: Quest 'Dancing for the Factory' (Project 1): click your Disco Dynamo with a music disc and up to 4 guhs come dancing.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.droom.1: This is the Dream Factory: cheese nibble plants in, fried nibbles and vahoege potions out!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.droom.2: Every machine here also has its own stand at the fair. Build them all and make your own dream factory at home.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.droom.3: Turn off the big switch by the core and watch everything fall asleep. Do switch it back on, though!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.guhrad.1: My guh has been running all day. He thinks there's a nibble at the end. Don't tell him!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.guhrad.2: You build a Guh Wheel yourself: start at the quest 'A Guh at Work' in Guh Technology. A happy guh gives 15 instead of 10.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.kern.1: A real star, in a little cage. In the evening he's allowed out for a bit to twinkle.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.kern.2: This core runs half the fair: 200 chonk power! You build it at the end of The Great Nibble Machine, with a glowstar.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.knabbelaar.1: One puts a stone down, the other nibbles it up. True friendship!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.knabbelaar.2: First get the recipe card at 'Nibbling Machines' (Project 4), then 'Stone Without a Pickaxe' and 'The Placer'.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.knuffel.1: This is the only generator you're allowed to cuddle. I wouldn't try it with the others.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.knuffel.2: Quest 'Happy Guhs Run Faster' (Project 1): tame guhs come and lie on the cushion by themselves, each gives 3 chonk power.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.knutsel.1: Nine nibbles in, one block out, and back again. They're very good at it.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.knutsel.2: Draw a recipe on the Drawing Table ('The Drawing Table') and put the drawing in the Tinker Machine ('Tinkering Without Hands').
quest.guhs.techbeurs.molen.1: Milling without wind! The miller next door is a little jealous.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.molen.2: Quest 'Milling Without Wind' for the Chonk Mill and 'The Oven with a Little Snoot' for the Guh Oven, both in Project 1.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.oogster.1: He harvests, he plants again and he never complains. I wish I were like that.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.oogster.2: Quest 'The Field That Harvests Itself' (Project 2). Point his snoot at your field, with water and light nearby.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.opzuiger.1: Don't drop anything here. Really. He's faster than you.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.opzuiger.2: Quest 'The Slurper' (Project 2). The Guh Clock that taps the dropper is a sensor from 'Enough Is Enough'.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.plantagebak.1: A whole forest in a box. Well, one tree. But a very nice one.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.plantagebak.2: You earn the recipe card at the Grill Camping; quest 'A Forest in a Box' (Project 4). Chop the tree down and it plants a new one.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.pomp.1: The source never runs dry. We're very proud of that here, nyeg.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.pomp.2: Pumps, hoses and vats are in Project 3, 'Sauce on Tap'. Start at the recipe card 'Sauce and Hoses'.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.sauzen.1: Potions, fried snacks and grill coal from one and the same hose. Now that's what I call a sauce street!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.sauzen.2: See 'Fry-Up on the Assembly Line', 'Potions That Brew Themselves' and 'The Grill Coal Line' in Project 3.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.welkom.1: Welcome to the Guh Technology Fair! Everything here really runs. Go ahead and flip the little switches off and on again, nyeg!
quest.guhs.techbeurs.welkom.2: Looking is fine, taking is not: what's in the stands belongs to the fair. The fair guhs tell you how to build it yourself.
quest.guhs.techbeurs.welkom.3: In the middle is the Dream Factory: everything works together there. My favourite stand!
structure.guhs.guhtechniek_beurs.tooltip: A glass hall where every guh machine really works, with the Dream Factory in the middle
